== Summary ==
Original Japanese [[Han's Dice (Japanese Premiere Two-Player)|Han's Dice]] from [[Premiere Introductory Two-Player Game (Japanese)]]. Card-face crop from [https://swccgcards.com/product/jpn-premiere-wb-ls-hans-dice/ SWCCG Cards], [https://swccgcards.com/wp-content/uploads/2022/01/jpn_premiere_wb_ls_Han_s_Dice.png source photograph].

Crop rectangle <code>(8, 6, 843, 1194)</code> after applying the source orientation. Source SHA-256 <code>4f35ee04ee45e29ce9617479e82f04c9d95da2b91a6d798e2c888ae10601c0da</code>. Lucasfilm Ltd. and Decipher Inc., 1997.
